# Let's parse the note content into a list of (title, artists) pairs.
note_content = note['content']
lines = note_content.strip().split('\n')
# Skip the first line which is the header
song_lines = lines[1:]
songs = []
for line in song_lines:
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    # Split by " by " to get title and artist part
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        songs.append((title, artists))
    else:
        # If no " by ", maybe just title? But all lines have " by " based on content.
        songs.append((line.strip(), []))
print(songs)
